known_non_blocking_items: Verified-free core is intentionally small until credential-level evidence is promoted; free-price signals are not equivalent to verification.
Self-hosted runner is optional and not required for the production catalog pipeline.
The catalog is currently candidate-heavy; the next quality bottleneck is evidence promotion and credential-to-skill mapping, not raw row count.
Pathway mappings are heuristic candidates and require future evidence-backed review before any authoritative learning claim.
Release snapshots currently describe catalog provenance/statistics; they are not verification evidence.
The release indicator is service-worker mediated, so a first-time visitor may need one subsequent navigation after the new service worker is installed before seeing it.

The current service worker update for promotion workspace caching was not applied because the connector rejected that particular change; the promotion route remains fully online and deployed through Pages.
